newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells stake in three small trading firms.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells stake in three small trading firms.

text.p: Croatia's state privatisation agency sold its stakes in three small trading firms, worth 214,700 German marks, the Zagreb Stock Exchange reported on Thursday.

At a regular weekly cash auction of the Croatian Privatisation Fund holdings, it sold its 23.5 percent interest in Elting d.d. for 112,200 marks to Slavonska Banka d.d., the bourse said in a press release.
Another, 19.9 percent stake at Komunalac d.d. was sold to EA sistem d.o.o. for 12,500 marks.
Privredna Banka d.d. bought the Fund's 13.4 percent interest at Konstruktor Zlatar for 90,000 marks.
Apart from cash sales, the Fund also holds Monday auctions on the bourse for the remaining shares in its portfolio that are payable in public debt notes at a discount of up to 30 percent.
But investor interest has weakened considerably since the most attractive and profitable companies were sold.
